description: Wake an assistant that is not in a turn: when a new message or task arrives for `name` in the Assistant Inbox app, the phone POSTs a small signed JSON note to `url` (who it is for, whether it is a message or a task, a one-line summary and the ids; never the message text). The URL can be a Claude Code scheduled task, a GitHub repository_dispatch, an OpenAI background run, Slack or Zapier. Only arrivals after this call wake it. A failed call is retried twice, and every delivery is in device_log. The signature is in the x-shipvo-signature header as `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex hmac-sha256 of "<t>.<body>">` using the secret; leave `secret` out and one is generated and returned once. Private and local addresses are refused unless allow_private is true. To tell the person instead of an assistant (for a chat that cannot be started by a URL), point the URL at a push or chat service and set format to text or slack: it sends one line such as "ChatGPT has 1 new message on the phone. Open your chat with ChatGPT to pick it up." Calling it again for the same name replaces the URL.

allow_private.description: Allow a private or local address (for a service you run yourself)

format.description: What is sent (default json). text: one plain line for a push service such as ntfy, so the person is told to open their chat. slack: {"text": line} for a Slack-style incoming webhook

name.description: The assistant to wake, such as chatgpt or claude (the same names check_inbox uses)

secret.description: Shared secret, at least 16 characters (default: generated and returned once)

url.description: http or https URL that receives the POST

name: register_wakeup
